articles.title: Rupee slips with traders clinging to equity cues, awaiting inflation data
articles.description: The Indian rupee faced a setback on Thursday, dipping to 94.0425 against the dollar amidst rising oil prices and escalating inflation fears. Previously, it had seen a peak of 93.62 thanks to foreign portfolio inflows. Investors are now holding their breath for October's consumer inflation figures, as they could significantly influence upcoming policy decisions and market sentiment surrounding the rupee.

articles.title: India Becomes Second-Largest Buyer Of Russian Fossil Fuels In October With €6.4 Billion Imports
articles.description: India emerged as the second-largest buyer of Russian fossil fuels in October, importing €6.4 billion worth, according to CREA. Crude oil accounted for most purchases, while China remained the largest buyer. Higher oil prices boosted Russian export earnings, as Indian refineries increased crude imports and exports of refined products overseas

articles.title: India’s Russian fossil fuel imports hit record €6.4 billion in October: CREA
articles.description: India was the worlds second-largest buyer of Russian fossil fuels in October, with purchases hitting a record €6.4 billion, according to CREA, as crude oil imports rose across major Indian refineries. Higher global oil prices also lifted Russias overall fossil-fuel export revenues to their highest monthly level since December 2022, despite Western sanctions and price caps.
